propositions: A ticket declaring file_impact_scope=none must have its no-file-impact assertion validated by an LLM criterion that judges whether the plan actually requires repository-file edits.
The no-file-impact criterion must be routed only when persisted scope is exactly 'none'; scope values 'paths', 'undeclared', missing, None, or unknown must not trigger the criterion.

The criterion must read ctx.state.get('no_file_impact_reason') and pass it into Pass-1 via deterministic structured context with field 'declared_reason', preserving quotes/newlines/Unicode and serializing missing reasons as empty string.

The criterion rubric must yield assertion_plausible=no (advisory contradiction) when repo_file_change_named=yes or required deliverables entail file edits; assertion_plausible=yes (PASS) only when reason_grounded=yes and repo_file_change_named=no; assertion_plausible=insufficient (non-blocking coaching) when reason_grounded is no or insufficient.
Repository-file reads or analysis remain compatible with file_impact_scope=none; documentation changes are not compatible because documentation is a repository file.

All test assertions must target observable seams (routing selection, LLM request payload, CLI explain output, verdict aggregation) and public contracts; no source-text grep or private implementation-shape assertions are permitted.
